title: Copy XY-Coordinates (ArrangeAndOrganize)

scenarios.title: Copy XY-Coordinates applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Copy XY-Coordinates (BtnCopyXY) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Copy XY-Coordinates payload contract is pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: Copy XY-Coordinates writes its position through the production clipboard codec: the serialized payload is the branded, versioned, invariant-culture 'openEfficiency:XY:v1:' form with finite-value checks, and the ownership test that ClearCopiedGeometry uses accepts only a valid current openEfficiency payload (never unrelated numeric clipboard text) while the paste parse also still accepts the retained legacy two- and four-value forms.

scenarios.title: Copy XY-Coordinates writes the exact payload to the clipboard in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Copy XY-Coordinates on one selected rectangle at (150,120) returns true and the clipboard payload parses back to exactly x=150 y=120, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.
